name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.5): the classic page tools (aspx_*) open a page only on the profile's own site. A page_url on another host, or on another application of the same host, is refused before anything is sent, as the REST tools already did, because the page is opened with the profile's signed-in session. A page_url that is only a path is refused with a pointer to the site map. The notes, comments and tests no longer carry a client's name or real site codes (KNOWLEDGE.md section 53). 0.81.4 proved a whole bank reconciliation statement ticked in one aspx_grid_batch call. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
